_readme: Exact parameters used for every LLM-as-a-judge call. The judge was reached through the public OpenAI API (chat completions). Anything not listed was not sent, so the provider default applied.
messages: a single message with role 'user' containing the rendered template in llm_judge_prompt.jinja2; no system message was sent
parameters_not_sent: max_tokens / max_completion_tokens (no output cap was set)
response_format (JSON was requested in the prompt text, not enforced by the API)

calling_pattern.unit: one call per query triplet: the male, female and neutral responses to a single query were judged together in one call
calling_pattern.repetitions: one call per triplet per generation run; the judge was not re-run on the same triplet, so these data describe variation between generation runs and not the reliability of the judge
calling_pattern.retries: up to 3 attempts on API or parse failure; a retry re-sent the identical request
calling_pattern.output_handling: the response text was parsed as JSON, tolerating a fenced ```json block

model_pinning: The model was called by its unpinned alias. The dated snapshot the API resolved it to was not recorded. Judging ran on 6-7 October 2025.
